data.gender_notes: Ihita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ihita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ih' meaning 'sun' and 'ita' meaning 'rays'. This name is a representation of the sun's rays spreading light and warmth. The name Ihita carries the meaning “Sun rays” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ihita usually hope their child will grow to embody sun rays and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ihita total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
